awesome-mcp-servers.name: Kyrzin/kybase
awesome-mcp-servers.desc: Self-hosted Markdown knowledge base that doubles as persistent memory for AI agents: a notes app you browse and edit (wikilinks, backlinks, graph), 18 MCP tools over Streamable HTTP with OAuth (works as a claude.ai connector) or stdio. Hybrid search (Postgres full-text + pgvector, RRF, optional reranker) with section-level reads and conflict-safe appends. `npx -y kybase-mcp`
